scope: Real PitSelectionFlow, FighterCard and PitHonorsPanel component harness; fixture rewards are not played victories; no complete game claim.
method: Bundled the real repository PitSelectionFlow, FighterCard, PitHonorsPanel and imported dependencies with esbuild. Only React state/handlers and canonical save fixtures belong to the harness. Local HTTP server serves original tracked asset bytes. Playwright controls an actual Chromium process.

limits: Component harness only; this is not a Next build, deployed application test or complete played fight.
Launch verifies the callback after real stage readiness, not gameplay combat/result progression.
Only the-pit full stage renderer and the first 24 roster entries/stage thumbnails are part of this targeted suite; no exhaustive 201-character / 187-stage certification.
Reduced-motion component prop is tested; the independent operating-system media-query path is not separately asserted.
Native selection/deselection drawings remain unavailable. Feedback states are interface behavior; no sprite or 1:1 lore/art certification is inferred.
Desktop and mobile refer to Chromium viewports, not physical device execution.
priorAttemptNotes: Initial local Chromium launcher was incomplete and Playwright CDN download returned 403; a recognized npm Chromium package was used successfully.
Early fixture asset collection used an abbreviated Machiko ID; corrected to machiko-noguchi with original tracked assets before final run.
An early run opened multiple stage contexts concurrently and the browser exited under memory pressure; final runner closes each scenario context before the next.
Initial portrait failure injection targeted PNG while the actual source is WebP; final run blocks the exact WebP request and verifies recovery.
sourceCommitKind: local-tested-commit; remote publication SHA is not asserted
sourceVerification: The 7 SHA-256 source fingerprints are the primary proof. Every fingerprint matches the local tested commit; a connector publication may create a different commit SHA with identical file contents.
publicationProof: Published tree equals the complete local tested tree; fetched branch and all seven SHA-256 fingerprints verified before adding this report.
